author: k. n. phillips
title: Senator Adam Schiff questions Binance activities and highlights DACA recipient concerns
text:
Senator Adam Schiff, a U.S. Congressman representing California’s 30th district, posted a series of tweets on June 16 and 17 addressing issues related to cryptocurrency, sanctions enforcement, and immigration policy.
On June 16, Schiff called attention to the actions of Binance and its connections to former President Trump’s family. In his post he stated, “Binance has repeatedly routed millions to Iran-backed proxy groups while also being a key backer of Trump’s crypto profiteering. I am demanding answers into Binance’s role in violating sanctions laws — and its business entanglements with the Trump family.”
Earlier that day, Schiff had shared another tweet referencing an external link: https://t.co/Pyqju3UMpy.
The following day, on June 17, Schiff addressed concerns regarding DACA recipients amid current federal immigration policies. He wrote, “DACA recipients are our doctors, engineers, and teachers — they are interwoven into our society and essential to our economy. But because of this administration’s draconian immigration policies, many fear they are only one court decision, even court appearance, away from https://t.co/uJUS0weYQ2”.
Adam Schiff has represented California’s 30th District in Congress since 2001 after previously serving in the California Senate from 1996 to 2000. Born in Framingham, Massachusetts in 1960 and currently residing in Burbank at age 62, Schiff holds degrees from Stanford University (BA) and Harvard University (JD).
